plan.analysis: All three classes fail on SMALL, low-contrast defects: inclusion recall 0.16 (low-size tertile 0.027, n=146; missed median 37px vs train 90px), patches 0.65 (low tertile 0.40, missed 50px vs 85px), scratches 0.58 (low tertile 0.40, missed 41px vs 73px). Inclusion is worst and most starved (10 real imgs, 158 misses) so it gets the largest share; patches/scratches stay fed to avoid starving the shared detector. Plan = bias every class toward small scales and small source defects to match the missed size band, staying above the unlearnable-tiny floor (scale_min 0.4). Corrected inclusion source list (287 was a typo for 297; 297 excluded because its mark is light on a white background and would not match the dark missed inclusions).
plan.rationale: Target the dominant failure mode (small, low-contrast defects) by scaling sources down into the ~35-70px band the model currently misses, using prefer_small weighting and small/medium source defects whose shape matches the misses (thin dark vertical marks for inclusion, small dark blobs for patches, thin bright lines for scratches; rotation/flip covers orientation so all scratch sources are used). Inclusion gets the most (24) because it is far below the others and most starved, but stays well under the ~80 diminishing-return threshold; patches (14) and scratches (12) remain fed so the shared detector is not starved. same_class backgrounds keep pastes realistic (dark inclusions/blobs on matching steel, bright lines on gray steel) and avoid invisible pastes on mismatched backgrounds. Inclusion sources restricted to the dark thin-mark defects (297 dropped as a light-on-white mark that would not resemble the dark missed inclusions).

plan.analysis: Preview check: inclusion pastes = thin dark vertical/horizontal marks on gray steel at small scale, matching the thin dark missed inclusions (misses 1,3,11,14,22). Patches pastes = small dark blobs on matching gray/white steel, matching the small dark missed patches (incl. low-contrast ones on darker steel). Scratches pastes = thin bright lines on gray steel, matching the thin bright missed scratches. All sizes fall in the small band the model misses; backgrounds are same-class and realistic; nothing looks wasted or unrealistic. Plan is good.
plan.rationale: Preview confirms the pastes reproduce the missed appearance (thin dark marks for inclusion, small dark blobs for patches, thin bright lines for scratches) at the small, low-contrast size band the detector currently fails on, on realistic same-class backgrounds.
